note: Default training growth curve: how much each main stat rises PER training level (0-30). FC Mobile's real per-level gains differ PER PLAYER and were not verifiable from a free public source. This is a placeholder default; each player can override it with their own growth values in the UI (Player form -> Growth). Effective stat at a hypothetical level = current stat + gain_per_level * (target_level - current_level).
